scope: single-model Kimi K2.5 continuation of G6/G7 scientific-gate work

findings.title: Formal statistical validity is not established
findings.evidence: A new isolated Q-v2 public cohort completed 92/92 cases with 103 recorded Kimi K2.5 calls, including 11 fixed format retries. Independent record/trace/proof audit passed. Recomputed verdicts are PASS 18, FAIL 8, INCONCLUSIVE 55, NOT_SCORED 11. The prespecified primary PASS fraction is 18/92 = 0.1957 (Clopper-Pearson 95% CI 0.1203-0.2915); the scoreable-subset fraction is 18/26 = 0.6923 (95% CI 0.4821-0.8567). No independent blinded truth labels exist, so this is a non-confirmatory verifier audit and the scientific gate remains blocked.
findings.remediation: Obtain an independent blinded truth set and domain-grade mathematical/statistical review before treating Q-v2 or G6 CF3 results as confirmatory evidence.

findings.title: All eligible G6 public proof graphs have no dependency edges for G7 localization
findings.evidence: A separate public-only LU-v2 Kimi K2.5 cohort made 11/11 real calls. Three responses produced independently validated non-final state transitions; eight produced no observed state change. The independent audit passed with no private labels, answer key, or frozen-G7 pooling, but this does not establish a causal U result.
findings.remediation: Increase independently audited public state-transition coverage and obtain protocol-approved causal analysis; retain the eight no-change cases as observed failures/non-events.

findings.title: G7 revalidation has trace lifecycle inconsistencies after append-only retry recovery
findings.evidence: The new Kimi K2.5 recovery remains 150/150 states and 72/72 checkpoints with 13/13 retry-target latest traces valid. The 13 historical lifecycle failures remain retained and are not retroactively cleared or merged into a clean historical denominator.
findings.remediation: Keep historical failures and corrected retry traces separately audited; do not relabel the historical denominator as clean without a protocol-approved reanalysis.

findings.title: Real-provider pilot and retry/cost behavior are unverified
findings.evidence: Authenticated read-only probes returned /models HTTP 200 with 241 records but no fingerprint-like fields; /usage, /billing, and /account/usage each returned HTTP 404. The probe sent no generation request. Local ledgers and provider traces remain useful execution evidence but do not verify provider billing or immutable weight/route identity.
findings.remediation: Obtain provider-verifiable billing/usage reconciliation and immutable route or weight identity; keep scientific release closed until independently verified.

findings.title: Upstream provenance and GitHub delivery are externally blocked
findings.evidence: The local branch contains the completed work, but push verification still fails through the configured proxy at 127.0.0.1:443. No remote push success is claimed.
findings.remediation: Restore an authorized network path or publish the local commit through an independently verified upstream channel; do not claim remote delivery until git ls-remote confirms it.

test.evidence: 87 passed; Q-v2 and LU-v2 independent audit scripts also completed with exit code 0 after the proof-reference path repair.
